SELECT m.id AS memberId, u.name AS memberName, u.tel AS tel,
ms.membership_num AS membershipNum, ms.type AS membershipType, ms.type_rep AS typeRep,
-- 날짜는 문자열로 변환 DATE_FORMAT(mr.start_date, '%Y.%m.%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(mr.end_date, '%Y.%m.%d') AS endDate,
-- 상태 계산 CASE WHEN mr.end_date < CURDATE() THEN 'expired' WHEN DATEDIFF(mr.end_date, CURDATE()) <= 7 THEN 'soon' ELSE 'active' END AS status,
-- 사용된 PT 횟수 IFNULL(pp.sessions_used, 0) AS usedPtCount,
-- 남은 PT 횟수 CASE WHEN ms.type = 'pt' THEN IFNULL(pp.total_sessions, 0) - IFNULL(pp.sessions_used, 0) ELSE 0 END AS remainPtCount
FROM member m JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.id
JOIN membership_registration mr ON mr.member_num = m.id
JOIN membership ms ON mr.membership_num = ms.membership_num
LEFT JOIN pt_package pp ON pp.client_id = m.id AND pp.trainer_id = m.trainer_id
WHERE m.gym_id = #{gymId} AND u.is_deleted = false
AND ( u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.tel LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND ms.type = 'pt'
AND ms.type != 'pt'
AND ( CASE WHEN mr.end_date < CURDATE() THEN 'expired' WHEN DATEDIFF(mr.end_date, CURDATE()) <= 7 THEN 'soon' ELSE 'active' END ) = #{status}
GROUP BY mr.mr_num
ORDER BY mr.end_date ASC
LIMIT #{start}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.gym_id = #{value} AND u.is_deleted = false
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.gym_id = #{value} AND u.is_deleted = false AND DATE_FORMAT(u.created_at, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')

AND ( u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.tel LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
